pairs: And the entire multitude of them,
rising up, led him to Pilate.
Then they began to accuse him,
“We found this one subverting our nation,
and prohibiting giving tribute to Caesar,
et dicentem se Christum regem esse.
and saying that he is Christ the king.”
“You are the king of the Jews?”
Ait autem Pilatus ad principes sacerdotum et turbas:
Then Pilate said to the leaders of the priests and to the crowds,
Nihil invenio causæ in hoc homine.
“I find no case against this man.”
But they continued more intensely, saying:
Commovet populum docens per universam Judæam,
“He has stirred up the people, teaching throughout all of Judea,
beginning from Galilee, even to this place.”
asked if the man were of Galilee.
Et ut cognovit quod de Herodis potestate esset,
And when he realized that he was under Herod’s jurisdiction,
he sent him away to Herod,
qui et ipse Jerosolymis erat illis diebus.
who was himself also at Jerusalem in those days.
Erat enim cupiens ex multo tempore videre eum,
For he had been wanting to see him for a long time,
eo quod audierat multa de eo,
because he had heard so many things about him,
et sperabat signum aliquod videre ab eo fieri.
and he was hoping to see some kind of sign wrought by him.
Then he questioned him with many words.
But he gave him no response at all.
Stabant autem principes sacerdotum et scribæ constanter accusantes eum.
And the leaders of the priests, and the scribes, stood firm in persistently accusing him.
Sprevit autem illum Herodes cum exercitu suo:
Then Herod, with his soldiers, scorned him.
And he ridiculed him, clothing him in a white garment.
And he sent him back to Pilate.
Et facti sunt amici Herodes et Pilatus in ipsa die:
And Herod and Pilate became friends on that day.
nam antea inimici erant ad invicem.
For previously they were enemies to one another.
calling together the leaders of the priests,
dixit ad illos: Obtulistis mihi hunc hominem,
said to them: “You have brought before me this man,
as one who disturbs the people.
et ecce ego coram vobis interrogans,
And behold, having questioned him before you,
nullam causam inveni in homine isto ex his in quibus eum accusatis.
I find no case against this man, in those things about which you accuse him.
For I sent you all to him,
et ecce nihil dignum morte actum est ei.
nothing deserving of death was recorded about him.
Therefore, I will chastise him and release him.”
Necesse autem habebat dimittere eis per diem festum unum.
Now he was required to release one person for them on the feast day.
But the entire crowd exclaimed together,
qui erat propter seditionem quamdam factam in civitate et homicidium missus in carcerem.
Now he had been cast into prison because of a certain sedition that occurred in the city and for murder.
Iterum autem Pilatus locutus est ad eos,
Then Pilate spoke to them again,
Ille autem tertio dixit ad illos:
Then he said to them a third time:
nullam causam mortis invenio in eo:
I find no case against him for death. Therefore,
I will chastise him and release him.”
At illi instabant vocibus magnis postulantes ut crucifigeretur:
But they persisted, with loud voices, in demanding that he be crucified.
And their voices increased in intensity.
Et Pilatus adjudicavit fieri petitionem eorum.
And so Pilate issued a judgment granting their petition.
Dimisit autem illis eum qui propter homicidium
Then he released for them the one who had been cast into prison for murder and sedition,
et seditionem missus fuerat in carcerem,
Jesus he handed over to their will.
And as they were leading him away,
apprehenderunt Simonem quemdam Cyrenensem venientem de villa:
they apprehended a certain one, Simon of Cyrene, as he was returning from the countryside.
et imposuerunt illi crucem portare post Jesum.
And they imposed the cross on him to carry after Jesus.
Sequebatur autem illum multa turba populi et mulierum,
Then a great crowd of people followed him,
with women who were mourning and lamenting him.
But Jesus, turning to them, said:
sed super vos ipsas flete et super filios vestros.
Instead, weep over yourselves and over your children.
Quoniam ecce venient dies in quibus dicent:
For behold, the days will arrive in which they will say,
and the wombs that have not borne,
and the breasts that have not nursed.’
Then they will begin to say to the mountains,
Quia si in viridi ligno hæc faciunt,
For if they do these things with green wood,
what will be done with the dry?”
Ducebantur autem et alii duo nequam cum eo,
Now they also led out two other criminals with him,
Et postquam venerunt in locum qui vocatur Calvariæ,
And when they arrived at the place that is called Calvary,
and the other to the left.
For they know not what they do.”
et deridebant eum principes cum eis, dicentes:
watching. And the leaders among them derided him,
si hic est Christus Dei electus.
if this one is the Christ, the elect of God.”
Illudebant autem ei et milites accedentes,
And the soldiers also ridiculed him,
approaching him and offering him vinegar,
“If you are the king of the Jews,
Erat autem et superscriptio scripta super eum litteris græcis,
Now there was also an inscription written over him in letters of Greek,
This is the king of the Jews.
Unus autem de his, qui pendebant, latronibus,
And one of those robbers who were hanging blasphemed him,
But the other responded by rebuking him,
“Do you have no fear of God,
since you are under the same condemnation?
And indeed, it is just for us.
For we are receiving what our deeds deserve.
But truly, this one has done nothing wrong.”
memento mei cum veneris in regnum tuum.
remember me when you come into your kingdom.”
this day you shall be with me in Paradise.”
Now it was nearly the sixth hour,
et tenebræ factæ sunt in universam terram usque ad horam nonam.
and a darkness occurred over the entire earth, until the ninth hour.
et velum templi scissum est medium.
And the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.
Et clamans voce magna Jesus ait:
And Jesus, crying out with a loud voice,
in manus tuas commendo spiritum meum.
“Father, into your hands I commend my spirit.”
Videns autem centurio quod factum fuerat,
Now, the centurion, seeing what had happened,
this man was the Just One.”
Et omnis turba eorum, qui simul aderant ad spectaculum istud, et videbant quæ fiebant,
And the entire crowd of those who came together to see this spectacle also saw what had happened,
and they returned, striking their breasts.
Stabant autem omnes noti ejus a longe,
Now all those who knew him,
and the women who had followed him from Galilee,
quæ secutæ eum erant a Galilæa,
there was a man named Joseph,
(for he had not consented to their decision or their actions).
qui exspectabat et ipse regnum Dei:
And he was himself also anticipating the kingdom of God.
hic accessit ad Pilatum et petiit corpus Jesu:
This man approached Pilate and petitioned for the body of Jesus.
And taking him down, he wrapped him in a fine linen cloth,
et posuit eum in monumento exciso,
and he placed him in a tomb hewn from rock,
in quo nondum quisquam positus fuerat.
in which no one had ever been placed.
And it was the day of Preparation,
and the Sabbath was drawing near.
Now the women who had come with him from Galilee,
quæ cum eo venerant de Galilæa,
et quemadmodum positum erat corpus ejus.
and the manner in which his body was placed.
And upon returning, they prepared aromatic spices and ointments.
et sabbato quidem siluerunt secundum mandatum.
indeed, they rested, according to the commandment.
